items.title: 3M (MMM) Looks Fairly Valued After Its PFAS Settlement Put A Key Risk In View
items.summary: 3M (MMM) just put a price tag and a timetable on a major legal overhang, agreeing to a US$7.35b PFAS personal injury settlement that defines cash outflows over nine years. Despite a 1-day share price return that declined 1.4% to US$186.24, 3M has logged a 30-day share price return of 14.42% and a year to date share price return of 15.09%. This suggests momentum has picked up as investors reassess legal risk after the PFAS settlement, dividend affirmation, and a new US$6.0b buyback...

items.title: 3M Cut Its Dividend After 64 Years of Raises. Is It Finally a Buy Again?
items.summary: 3M broke a 64-year streak, shed its forever-chemicals baggage, and just settled its biggest legal fight. Retirees now face a harder question: do the payout math, the cash drains, and two rival dividend payers justify trusting the company with income again?
